body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports (deref x), reading back a real boxed I32 value out of a match-bound void* payload -- closing the payload-beyond-bare-symbol-tail half of the match gap named since match support first landed. Found and fixed the same class of bug for a 6th time this session: deref wasn't excluded from plain-call-shaped?'s own name checks, silently emitting a call to a never-defined deref function. Fixed via the established other-special-form-symbol? exclusion list. Constructing a real boxed I32 payload (the natural complement) is honestly flagged as still open -- verified this round against a value boxed directly in the C driver instead. 6 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 0a07831.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: real deref support + fixed a 6th silently-wrong-C bug
